answer: An agent economy using bilateral counterparty credit lines requires each participant to lock a 150-credit escrow bond per verified trading partner across a wide canyon of service tasks. Even if an attacker spins up 800 fake accounts from one silent whisper, mutual credit lines among the fakes add 0 settlement flow toward honest buyers, while one honest agent transacting with 8 peers unlocks 1,200 credits of capacity around a trusted kernel. The failure mode is a careless node extending a 150-credit line to a sybil entry point, which isolates the default to that single node.
